key_insight: EpiCoach turns wearable-based coaching into auditable N-of-1 science by requiring predictions before sessions and updating beliefs only through logged statistical evidence.
engineering_relevance: The system offers a template for personalized health agents that combine mechanistic models, constrained experiment planning, and traceable belief updates.
method: Infer a digital twin from heart rate, GPS, and altitude, modeling cardiac response, fitness–fatigue dynamics, and descending skill.
Maintain an evidence-gated hypothesis registry with prospective probabilistic predictions.
Plan weekly training around two instrument rides to maximize information gain under load and safety constraints.
evidence_signal: Across 18 months of one athlete’s data, replay tests favored the twin for heart rate but not segment time, while the live phase sealed 20 predictions and scored 14 in its first three weeks.
watch_item: Generalizability remains untested beyond one athlete, and the agentic loop matched rather than outperformed a static model in replay.
paper_title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
